claim: Lovable apps deploy on a free *.lovable.app subdomain that cannot be removed and remains as a permanent fallback even after a custom domain is attached; custom domains require a paid plan and automatic SSL is provisioned.
quote: A custom domain lets you use your own domain or subdomain for your Lovable project instead of the default xxx.lovable.app URL... When you connect a custom domain to your Lovable app, Lovable automatically generates and installs an SSL certificate for it.

claim: Bolt publishes every project to a free *.bolt.host subdomain immediately, with custom domains gated to paid plans and connection done via Project Settings -> Domains & Hosting plus DNS record entry.
quote: When you publish a project with Bolt, it automatically goes live on a free bolt.host domain... Custom domains are only available on paid plans.

claim: Netlify gives every site a free *.netlify.app subdomain that keeps working as a fallback, and attaching a custom domain you already own is free on any plan including the free tier.
quote: You can use your own domain for your Netlify site for free... The Netlify subdomain URLs will always work even if you set up a custom domain for your site.

claim: Replit deployments get a free *.replit.app subdomain with auto-SSL, but linking a custom domain requires a Core/Pro/Enterprise paid plan and the user must paste A and TXT records into their registrar.
quote: Every deployed website receives a free replit.app subdomain automatically with SSL encryption... Custom domains require a paid Replit plan.

claim: Replit ships a one-click Domain Purchasing flow inside the platform that searches, buys, and auto-configures DNS to point at the app in under a minute, with WHOIS privacy included free.
quote: With one click, users can buy a domain and have it automatically configured to point to their Replit app, with the full setup from search to live site taking under a minute.

claim: Vercel Domains sells domains at registrar cost (no markup) with instant availability search and one-click attach to Vercel projects.
quote: Domains are offered at registrar cost, with savings up to 50% on popular TLDs. Availability and pricing surface instantly, with no upsells or unnecessary add-ons.

claim: On Vercel a custom domain is added by entering the URL in the project's Domains settings, then setting an A record for apex or CNAME for a subdomain; free Hobby accounts allow up to 50 custom domains per project.
quote: To add a custom domain to your project, navigate to the Domains section under the Settings tab for the project, enter the URL for your custom domain and click 'Add'.

claim: Cloudflare Registrar sells .com domains at the wholesale price of $10.44/year with zero markup, free WHOIS privacy, and free DNSSEC, but only works if the domain uses Cloudflare nameservers.
quote: Cloudflare Registrar does not mark up domain prices... A .com domain costs $10.44/year at both registration and renewal, with zero markup.

claim: Porkbun registers and renews .com at approximately $10.91/year with near-identical registration/renewal pricing, beating Namecheap's $18.48 .com renewal over multi-year ownership.
quote: Porkbun .com registration is $9.73... Porkbun .com renewal is $10.91. Porkbun keeps registration and renewal prices almost identical.

claim: is-a.dev gives developers a free *.is-a.dev subdomain with Cloudflare-backed DNS and SSL, registered by opening a pull request on GitHub — no credit card and the project commits to staying free.
quote: is-a.dev is a free subdomain service that provides .is-a.dev subdomains for developers... This project is a free service for developers and will stay that way.

claim: js.org offers free *.js.org subdomains via a four-step GitHub PR submission, but only accepts JavaScript-related projects such as NPM packages, libraries, and tooling.
quote: Only projects such as NPM packages, JS programming libraries, and tools that have a clear direct relation to JavaScript will be accepted.

claim: Replit's in-platform domain purchasing supports .com, .ai and other popular TLDs and bundles auto-DNS configuration, removing the entire concept of editing A/CNAME records for non-technical users.
quote: Search, purchase, and configure custom domains for your apps directly within the Replit platform—eliminating the need to use external domain registrars.
